fr_html: Après l'adoption de l'article, M. ADATCI, dont l'amendement principal est rejeté, reprend la proposition de M. Ricci-Busatti concernant la disjonction du statut de la Cour de toute la question de la compétence de celle-ci.
en_html: After the adoption of the Article, M. ADATCI, whose principal amendment had been rejected, again took up the proposal made by M. Ricci-Busatti, to omit the whole question of competence from the Statute of the Court.
